BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   B. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   C. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

6. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   C. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Money as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.

12. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   D. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Global Influence in Business 3.1 Public and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance 3.2 International Trade 4.0 Financial Records in Business 4.1 Bus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
